title: Correos, códigos postales y telecomunicaciones en España

words.translation: Spanish State Postal Service (Sociedad Estatal Correos y Telégrafos)
postal / ZIP code (5 digits in Spain; first 2 = province)
international telephone dialing code (+34 for Spain)
registered letter (with official proof of delivery)
landline telephone (9 digits starting with 9 or 8)
mobile / cell phone (9 digits starting with 6 or 7)
